s2.note: sfpuc-icon-t8s-ssplit-rain-lzflags's own S2 (shared8_nonneg_sfpuc4), fold by fold: T1 and T1-holdout the final pick's design (shared8, low bends; chosen on all nine T2 seasons, so T1-holdout is development), each T2 season the design its outer fold's A5 procedure chose inside that fold ({'2016-17': 'shared8', '2017-18': 'shared8', '2018-19': 'shared8', '2019-20': 'shared8', '2020-21': 'shared8', '2021-22': 'four', '2022-23': 'shared8', '2023-24': 'shared8', '2024-25': 'shared8'}); weights and the picked volume heads ({'westside': 'loglinear', 'north_shore': 'loglinear', 'central': 'loglinear', 'south': 'loglinear'}) refit on each season set the fold's S3 asks for, with that fold's design. The volume recipe pick saw every season (development; stages_s2_sfpuc4).

note: Westside's two links share its overflow by s(v̂) = logistic(a + b·log1p v̂), v̂ the basin size predicted from rain, fit on v̂ out of sample (inner leave-one-season-out); the other links are identity; East is the union of Central and South by the rule chosen nested on chained East Brier.

fit.v_hat: a fit day's v̂ is the fold's head design refit without that day's season (inner leave-one-season-out); a scored day's v̂ is the fold's head (Part B 2: shares fit on v̂ the same way they are used); a season whose inner head would read fewer than 20 known-volume events is not fit on (no declared Westside fallback, Part B 7; the fold's fit_days_dropped)
fit.fit_rows: the S3 oracle's scored rows of the split zones on the fold's training days (X-S3-UNCOV, X-LEDGER-SUSPECT, X-S3-CARRY, X-S3-QUIET)
